request.subject: EFFECT:SHRINE_BLESSING

layers.text: Erase everything except the big four-pointed star of light and the small sparkles around it: remove the pedestal, the round grass disc and the soil under the star completely, so the star floats alone on a transparent background. Recolour the star and the sparkles to warm white #fff6d8 with the shadow tone #e8d8a0, not orange.
